WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, DIRECTORS BETTENCOURT, DISPENZA AND HOFBAUER

Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)

SA5.1

(Staff Reference: Director of Finance St. John)

1.
CALL TO ORDER.
Chair Ledford called the meeting to order at 7:50 p.m.
2.
ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, DIRECTORS BETTENCOURT, DISPENZA AND HOFBAUER
PRESENT:
Chair Ledford, Director Bettencourt, Director Dispenza, Director Hofbauer.
ABSENT:
Vice Chair Lackey.
Motion: Excuse abesence of Director Lackey
Moved by Director Bettencourt,
seconded by Director Dispenza.
Vote: Motion carried (4-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Director Bettencourt, Director Dispenza, Director Hofbauer.
Absent: Vice Chair Lackey.
3.
WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Motion: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.
Moved by Director Dispenza,
seconded by Director Hofbauer.
Vote: Motion carried (4-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Director Bettencourt, Director Dispenza, Director Hofbauer.
Absent: Vice Chair Lackey.
4.
CONSENT CALENDAR - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
None.
5.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
5.1
Accept the monthly report on the investment balances as reported on the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale's books as of February 28, 2013. (Staff Reference: Director of Finance St. John)
5.2
Adopt Resolution No. SA 2013-006, a Resolution of the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale ratifying and approving all Successor Agency warrants issued and voided on behalf of the Successor Agency to the Community Redevelopment Agency of the City of Palmdale since the last Successor Agency warrant register dated January 30, 2013 and Payroll Register Dated January 31, 2013 and approved by the Successor Agency on March 6, 2013. (Staff Reference: Director of Finance St. John)
5.3
Approve the Minutes from the previous meetings held on February 25, 2013 (6:00 pm) and March 6, 2013 (7:00 pm). (Staff Reference: Agency Secretary Smith)
Motion: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under the Consent Calendar.
Moved by Director Hofbauer,
seconded by Director Bettencourt.
Vote: Motion carried (4-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Director Bettencourt, Director Dispenza, Director Hofbauer.
Absent: Vice Chair Lackey.
6.
PUBLIC COMMENTS HEARD JOINTLY WITH CITY COUNCIL AND HOUSING AUTHORITY:
Jackie Perez and Cat Sanchez, with petition, spoke regarding traffic light at Domenic Massari Park.
Assistant Director of Public Works/City Engineer Heffernan provided a report regarding traffic signal at Domenic Massari Park.
Marsha Furman spoke regarding the upcoming Relay for Life.
7.
ADJOURNMENT:
Chair Ledford adjourned the meeting at 8:15 p.m. to May 1, 2013 at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Suite B, Palmdale, California.
PASSED, APPROVED and ADOPTED this 1st day of May 2013.
